I have a credit card and I pay outstanding amount before incurring any interest by bank. Bank offers discount of 3% on every transaction done through Credit card. For example if I have a transaction of AED 100 on credit card then I have to pay AED 97 before due date. Please advise whether discount of AED 3 offered by Bank is Hallal? 4581 views Q. I have a question regarding taxi cabs in Chicago. Is it allowable to tranport drunk passengers? Let me explain you the situation here: During morning shifts(5Am to 5PM) the passengers are mostly those going to office, airport or shopping malls. But during evening shifts, customers are mostly going to Bars/Pubs/strip clubs. There are certain streets which have bars one after the other. Going on those streets means you are going near bars. Also cabbies line up outside famous bars/pubs. If you want to avoid these customers you have to take small streets where you are almost certain of not getting any customers. Then to pick up customers you have to go to office areas which will be very far. After 11PM there is hardly anyone else on the streets other than drunk revelers. Another issue you can consider is that if anyone is trying to flag you down, you cannot refuse them. But that is just a rule and can be conveniently broken. In short avoiding bar areas is feasible but you make 1/3rd of what other people make. 2137 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 151057 Country: India Title: Can we buy items from Chor Bazar in Delhi as people say that thief sells there items which they steal. Question: Can we buy items from Chor Bazar in Delhi as people say that thief sells there items which they steal. Answer ID: 151057 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 981/870/H=8/1438) It is not lawful for you to buy such goods about which you know that they were achieved through theft, but if you have only doubt then it shall not be taken into consideration. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
